words.tr: adj. 有偏见的； v. “bias”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The judge was biased against the defendant.
words.ex_cn: 这位法官对被告有偏见。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.tr: n. 实习工作；安排；放置；
words.ex: He got a placement at a local company this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天获得了一份在本地公司的实习工作。
words.en: The act of placing something or someone in a particular position or the process of finding a suitable place or job for someone.

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.ex: I assure you that everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr: n. （美）餐馆工（等于 bus boy）
words.ex: The busboy clears the tables after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗工在晚饭后清理桌子。
words.en: A busboy is a person who works in a restaurant or cafeteria, doing tasks such as clearing tables and assisting the waiters and waitresses.

words.tr: adj. 矮胖的；肮脏破旧的
words.ex: She was a dumpy woman with a cheerful disposition.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个矮胖的女人，但性格开朗。
words.en: If you describe someone as dumpy, you mean they are short and fat in a way that is not attractive.

words.tr: adj. 说话含糊不清的；舌头笨拙的
words.ex: He became thick-tongued after drinking too much alcohol.
words.ex_cn: 他喝太多酒后说话含糊不清。
words.en: Unable to speak clearly because of a thick tongue or other physical condition.

words.tr: n. 综合征；综合症状；典型表现；
words.ex: He was diagnosed with sleep apnea syndrome.
words.ex_cn: 他被诊断出患有睡眠呼吸暂停综合征。
words.en: A syndrome is a set of medical signs and symptoms which are correlated with each other and often associated with a particular disease or disorder.

words.tr: phrase. 唐氏综合征（一种由染色体异常引起的先天性遗传病，导致智力障碍和特殊面部特征）
words.ex: Children with Down's syndrome often require special education.
words.ex_cn: 患有唐氏综合症的儿童通常需要特殊教育。
words.en: A congenital disorder caused by the presence of an extra chromosome 21, characterized by intellectual disability and distinctive physical features.

words.ex: I take the bus to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天乘公共汽车去学校。
words.en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another.

words.tr: adj. 说大话的，爱说话的
words.ex: He was always the mouthy one in the group, never afraid to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他总是那个在团体中爱说话的人，从不害怕说出自己的想法。
words.en: If you describe someone as mouthy, you are critical of them because they talk a lot, especially in a rude or offensive way.

words.tr: n. 雅皮士（属于中上阶层的年轻专业人士）
words.ex: The yuppie lifestyle often includes expensive cars and designer clothes.
words.ex_cn: 雅皮士的生活方式通常包括昂贵的汽车和名牌服装。
words.en: A yuppie is a young city professional, especially one with a well-paid job and a fashionable lifestyle.

words.tr: n. 势利小人；谄上欺下的人；恃才傲物的人
words.ex: He acts like a snob because he only likes expensive things.
words.ex_cn: 他只喜欢昂贵的东西，所以表现得像个势利小人。
words.en: A snob is someone who thinks they are better than other people because they are more intelligent, more cultured, or of a higher social class.

words.ex: She polished the silverware before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她在晚餐前擦拭了银器。
words.en: Silverware refers to items made of silver, especially tableware such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.ex: He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸巾擦了擦嘴。
words.en: A napkin is a piece of cloth or paper used at meals to protect your clothes and to wipe your mouth and fingers.

words.ex: He left early for fear of missing the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早离开，怕赶不上公交车。
words.en: If you do something for fear of something else, you do it to avoid that other thing happening.

words.tr:
v. 害怕；畏惧
n. 恐惧；畏惧
words.ex: He dreads going to the dentist.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕去看牙医。
words.en: If you dread something, you fear it intensely.

words.ex: The truckstop offers a variety of services for long-haul drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这家卡车服务站为长途司机提供多种服务。
words.en: A truckstop is a place where truck drivers can stop to rest, eat, and refuel their vehicles.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死病菌。
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.tr: phrase. 费用账户；报销账户（指公司为员工支付业务开销的账户）
words.ex: He uses his expense account for business trips.
words.ex_cn: 他用业务报销账户支付差旅费用。
words.en: An expense account is a financial arrangement that allows an employee to spend money on behalf of the company, with the costs being reimbursed by the company.

words.tr:
v. 调情；轻率地对待
n. 与多人调情的人
words.ex: He flirts with her at the coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在咖啡店向她调情。
words.en: If you flirt with someone, you behave as if you are sexually attracted to them, in a playful or not very serious way.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.w: wrap sb. around one's little finger
words.tr: phrase. 完全控制某人；把某人玩弄于股掌之中
words.ex: She can wrap him around her little finger and get him to do anything she wants.
words.ex_cn: 她能把他玩弄于股掌之间，让他做任何她想让他做的事。
words.en: To have complete control over someone, making them do whatever you want.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: The school mascot is a happy tiger.
words.ex_cn: 学校的吉祥物是一只快乐的老虎。
words.en: A mascot is a person, animal, or object that is adopted by a group as a symbolic figure to bring them good luck.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.ex: She reached for the pepper shaker to add more flavor to her dish.
words.ex_cn: 她伸手去拿胡椒瓶，给她的菜肴增添更多风味。
words.en: A container with small holes in the top, used for sprinkling pepper onto food.

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的位置；适当
words.ex: The books are in place on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地放在书架上。
words.en: In the correct position or location; ready for use.

words.ex: A crumb fell on the table after he ate the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完面包后，掉了一小块碎屑在桌子上。
words.en: A crumb is a very small piece of bread, cake, or biscuit.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.tr: phrase. 完成；处理完（某事）；结束（某人或某事）
words.ex: I just want to get done with this project and take a break.
words.ex_cn: 我只想完成这个项目然后休息一下。
words.en: To finish or complete something, especially something that has been taking a lot of time or effort.

words.ex: I'm done with this project.
words.ex_cn: 我已经完成了这个项目。
words.en: To finish or complete something, especially something that has been ongoing or troublesome.

words.ex: The bird hovers above the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在花上空盘旋。
words.en: To remain in one place in the air, or to stay close to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在背景中；在背后；不显眼地；在幕后
words.ex: She prefers to work in the background, away from the spotlight.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢在幕后工作，远离聚光灯。
words.en: In a position where one is not directly involved or noticed, often while others are more prominent.

words.ex: The farmer drove his cart full of apples to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫驾着装满苹果的运货马车去市场。
words.en: A cart is a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse or a person and is used for carrying goods.

words.ex: She meticulously cleaned every corner of the room.
words.ex_cn: 她异常细致地打扫了房间的每一个角落。
words.en: If you do something meticulously, you do it very carefully and with great attention to detail.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.ex: He wore a rag to clean the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块破布擦地板。
words.en: A rag is a piece of old cloth which you can use to clean or wipe things. As a verb, to rag means to tease or mock someone persistently.

words.tr:
v. 皱起；使起褶子；撅起
n. 皱纹；褶子
words.ex: He pucker his lips when he tastes sour lemon.
words.ex_cn: 他尝到酸柠檬时皱起了嘴唇。
words.en: To pucker means to tightly gather or contract into wrinkles or small folds.

words.ex: He takes pride in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他以帮助别人为荣。
words.en: To feel a sense of satisfaction or pleasure in one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions, or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.tr: phrase. 每一个的；各自的（强调全体中的每一个个体）
words.ex: Each and every student must submit their assignment by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生必须在周五前提交作业。
words.en: Every single one, without exception.

words.tr: phrase. 久而久之；随着时间的过去
words.ex: He gets better over time.
words.ex_cn: 他随着时间的推移变得更好。
words.en: If something happens over time, it happens gradually during a long period.

words.ex: The widow lives alone in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位寡妇独自住在一所小房子里。
words.en: A widow is a woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

words.tr: phrase. 社会保障；社会保险
words.ex: He receives social security every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都领取社会保障金。
words.en: A government system that provides financial assistance to people with an inadequate or no income.

words.ex: The social worker helps poor families.
words.ex_cn: 社会工作者帮助贫困家庭。
words.en: A social worker is a person whose job is to help people in a particular area who have social disadvantages or personal problems.

words.ex: The manager checks on the workers every hour.
words.ex_cn: 经理每小时监督工人们。
words.en: To verify or ensure the condition or status of something or someone.

words.ex: He visits his grandma every so often.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望奶奶。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.tr: phrase. 被忽视；被遗漏；从漏洞中掉下去（指在系统或过程中因疏忽而被忽略的人或事）
words.ex: Some students fall between the cracks in big schools.
words.ex_cn: 在大型学校中，一些学生会被忽视。
words.en: To be overlooked or missed, especially in a system or process.

words.ex: The water valve is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 这个水阀坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A valve is a device attached to a pipe or a tube which controls the flow of air or liquid through it.

words.tr: phrase. 到达；显现；实现；成功地完成；（健康）恢复；渡过
words.ex: The package will come through tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 包裹明天会到达。
words.en: To successfully deal with a difficult situation or to do what is needed or expected.

words.tr:
v. （使）成波浪状；（使）起涟漪；作潺潺声 
n. 微波；涟漪；潺潺声
words.ex: The wind ripples the surface of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 风使湖面泛起波浪。
words.en: If something ripples, it moves in small waves or if you ripple it, you make it move in small waves.

words.ex: He let out a loud scream.
words.ex_cn: 他大喊了一声。
words.en: To allow something to escape or be released; to reveal something that was supposed to be kept secret; to rent out property.

words.tr:
n. 呼喊；高呼
v. 叫喊；高呼
words.ex: The crowd let out a loud whoop when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众发出了一声大声的呼喊。
words.en: A whoop is a loud, excited shout, often expressing joy or enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. （原住民的）战斗呐喊；战争呼号
words.ex: The war whoop echoed through the valley as the warriors charged.
words.ex_cn: 战士们冲锋时，战吼在山谷中回荡。
words.en: A war whoop is a loud yell or cry made by warriors as they attack, intended to frighten the enemy and encourage their own side.

words.tr: n. 西迷舞，摇动 v. 摇动，震颤，晃动
words.ex: The car started to shimmy as we drove over the rough road.
words.ex_cn: 当我们驶过崎岖的道路时，汽车开始晃动。
words.en: A shimmy is a dance that involves shaking the body, especially the shoulders, or a shaking or wobbling movement.

words.tr:
n. 脸红；羞愧
v. 泛红；羞愧
words.ex: He felt shy and got a blush when she praised him.
words.ex_cn: 当他被她夸奖时，他感到害羞，脸红了。
words.en: If you blush, your face turns red because you are embarrassed or ashamed.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人投以（尤指不满或警告的）眼神
words.ex: She shot him a look that could kill.
words.ex_cn: 她迅速地看了他一眼，眼神中充满了杀气。
words.en: To give someone a look quickly, often conveying a specific emotion or message without words.

words.tr: phrase. 瞥某人一眼；迅速地看某人（常带有情绪，如愤怒、责备或警告）
words.ex: She shot a look at him, trying to gauge his reaction.
words.ex_cn: 她迅速看了他一眼，试图猜测他的反应。
words.en: To glance at someone quickly, often conveying a particular emotion or message without words.

words.ex: He wore a big grin after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得比赛后露出了灿烂的咧嘴笑容。
words.en: If you grin, you smile broadly, usually showing your teeth.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.tr: phrase. v. 度过难关；勉强应付；勉强维持生活
words.ex: He gets by with little money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠很少的钱维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have.

words.tr: phrase. 照现在的样子；实际上
words.ex: We thought things would get better, but as it is, they are getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 我们以为情况会好转，但事实上，情况正在恶化。
words.en: In the actual circumstances; in reality.

words.tr: phrase. 服侍；招待；焦急地等待
words.ex: The waitress waits on customers at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员在晚餐时服侍顾客。
words.en: To serve food and drink, especially to customers in a restaurant or at a table; to wait for something to happen or for someone to arrive.

words.ex: He gave a bold speech in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前发表了大胆的演讲。
words.en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

words.tr:
v. 潦草地写；涂写
n. 潦草的笔迹
words.ex: He scrawled his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上潦草地写了自己的名字。
words.en: If you scrawl something, you write it in a careless and untidy way.

words.ex: We eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节吃火鸡。
words.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated primarily in the United States and Canada as a day of giving thanks for the blessing of the harvest and of the preceding year.

words.tr: 短语动词. 意为热切地等待某事发生，一天天计算时间
words.ex: I count the days until summer vacation starts.
words.ex_cn: 我数着日子等待暑假开始。
words.en: To eagerly anticipate or look forward to a future event, often by marking the passage of time until it occurs.

words.ex: He put his job in jeopardy by being late every day.
words.ex_cn: 他因为每天迟到而危及了自己的工作。
words.en: Jeopardy is a situation of exposure to danger or harm.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.ex: The procession moved slowly down the street.
words.ex_cn: 行列缓缓沿着街道行进。
words.en: A procession is a group of people who are walking, riding, or driving in a line as part of a public event.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.ex: He put the cup on a saucer.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个茶托上。
words.en: A small shallow dish, typically circular, on which a cup is placed.

words.tr:
adj. 弯曲的；扭曲的；欺诈的；不老实的
v. （使）弯曲；使成钩状；“crook”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The path was crooked and hard to walk on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路是弯曲的，很难走。
words.en: If you describe something as crooked, especially something that is usually straight, you mean that it is bent or twisted.

words.ex: There are dozens of apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有很多苹果。
words.en: If you refer to dozens of things or people, you are emphasizing that there are very many of them.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.ex: The sailors cleaned the stern of the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手们打扫了船尾。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behavior as stern, you mean that they are severe or strict.

words.tr:
v. 偷看；窥视
n. 偷看；窥见
words.ex: He peeked through the keyhole.
words.ex_cn: 他从钥匙孔里偷看。
words.en: To peek means to look at something quickly and secretly, especially through a small opening or from behind something.

words.ex: She carefully arranged the tableware before the guests arrived.
words.ex_cn: 她在客人到来之前小心翼翼地摆放了餐具。
words.en: Tableware refers to the dishes, utensils, and other items used for serving and eating food at a table.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.tr:
adj. 令人痛苦的；折磨人的
n. 咬；苛责；不断的苦痛
v. 啃；咬；啮；折磨；侵蚀；“gnaw”的现在分词
words.ex: He felt a gnawing hunger after skipping lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐没吃，感到一阵阵饥饿。
words.en: If you describe a feeling as gnawing, you mean that it causes you to feel anxious or uncomfortable over a long period of time.

words.tr: n. 一阵剧痛；突然而强烈的情感
words.ex: He felt a pang of guilt after lying.
words.ex_cn: 他说谎后感到一阵内疚。
words.en: A pang is a sudden strong feeling of physical or emotional pain.

words.ex: The boy defied his parents by staying out late.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为熬夜不回家而违抗了父母。
words.en: If you defy someone or something, you refuse to obey them or you do something that they do not allow.

words.tr: adj. 压倒的；无法抗拒的；势不可挡的； v. “overwhelm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The crowd's cheers were overwhelming.
words.ex_cn: 人群的欢呼声压倒了一切。
words.en: If something is overwhelming, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

words.tr: v. 给予；发出；“give”的过去式；
words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: Past tense of give, which means to freely transfer the possession of something to someone.

words.ex: Parents shouldn't indulge their children's bad habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母不应该放任孩子的坏习惯。
words.en: To indulge means to allow yourself or someone else to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.ex: He has a black moustache.
words.ex_cn: 他有一撮黑色的胡子。
words.en: A moustache is the hair that grows on a man's upper lip.

words.ex: The puppy is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小狗在玩球。
words.en: A puppy is a young dog.

words.tr: phrase. 少男少女之间短暂而青涩的初恋；青春期恋爱
words.ex: They had puppy love in middle school.
words.ex_cn: 他们在中学时有过初恋。
words.en: Puppy love refers to the intense but relatively shallow romantic affection often felt by young people.

words.ex: The child blew a bubble with gum.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用口香糖吹了一个气泡。
words.en: A bubble is a small ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.tr: adj．毫不犹豫的，果断的：在行动或决策时没有犹豫或迟疑。
words.ex: She was unhesitant in her decision to leave the company.
words.ex_cn: 她毫不犹豫地决定离开公司。
words.en: If you are unhesitant, you do not hesitate or are not reluctant to do something.

words.ex: The mother grooms her puppy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈每天早上给她的小狗梳理毛发。
words.en: A groom is a man who is getting married. Also, to groom means to clean and brush an animal, or to prepare someone for a particular job or position.

words.tr: v. 使高兴，使兴奋( exhilarate的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: She felt exhilarated after finishing the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 她跑完马拉松后感到非常兴奋。
words.en: If you are exhilarated, you feel very happy and excited.

words.tr: v. 定居；安顿；解决；“settle”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 定居的；稳定的；
words.ex: They settled in Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年在加拿大定居了。
words.en: If you feel settled, you have become used to your new home, job, or situation, and you feel comfortable and happy about it.

words.tr: phrase. 互让；相互妥协；双向交流
words.ex: The relationship works because of the give and take between them.
words.ex_cn: 他们的关系之所以能维持，是因为他们之间的妥协和互相让步。
words.en: a process of compromise or cooperation where each side makes concessions

words.tr: phrasal verb. 以……为基础建设；在……之上建立
words.ex: He built his success on hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他将成功建立在努力工作和耐心的基础上。
words.en: To base something on a particular foundation or principle.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 以……为基础；建立在……之上
words.ex: He builds his success upon hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他将成功建立在努力和耐心之上。
words.en: To develop or base something on a particular foundation or principle.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.tr:
n. （果树的）花朵；
v. 开花；
words.ex: The apple tree is full of blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，苹果树上开满了花。
words.en: When a tree or plant blossoms, it produces flowers before producing fruit that can be eaten.

words.ex: She showed great affection for her little dog.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的小狗非常钟爱。
words.en: A feeling of liking and caring for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 思想上的共鸣；意见一致；心灵的交流
words.ex: They finally achieved a meeting of minds on the issue.
words.ex_cn: 他们最终在这个问题上达成了共识。
words.en: A situation in which two or more people or groups understand each other's ideas or opinions and agree about what to do.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: They wrote a love letter every day, and it became their romance.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天写一封情书，这成为了他们的浪漫史。
words.en: Romance refers to the feelings and behaviors characteristic of love, especially in its early stages, or a story, movie, or other work dealing with love in a sentimental or idealized way.

words.tr: adj. 短命的；持续不久的；昙花一现的
words.ex: The fashion trend was short-lived.
words.ex_cn: 这种时尚潮流是短暂的。
words.en: Something that is short-lived does not last very long.

words.ex: The apple's flesh is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的果肉又甜又多汁。
words.en: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or a human.

words.tr: adv. 浪费地；丰富地；大方地
words.ex: He lavishly spent money on fancy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他浪费地花钱买昂贵的衣服。
words.en: In a way that is very generous or extravagant.

words.tr:
adj. 理想的；
n. 理想；典范；
words.ex: This is the ideal place to relax.
words.ex_cn: 这是放松的理想地方。
words.en: An ideal is a principle or value that one actively pursues as a goal, often in the context of ethics or morality.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: The budget is a constraint on our project.
words.ex_cn: 预算是我们项目的限制。
words.en: A constraint is something that limits or controls what you can do.

words.ex: He showed restraint when he stayed calm during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持冷静，表现出了克制。
words.en: Restraint is a measure or condition that keeps someone or something under control or within limits.

words.ex: He felt admiration for his teacher's patience.
words.ex_cn: 他对他老师的耐心感到钦佩。
words.en: Admiration is a feeling of great liking and respect for someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 谦逊的；不夸耀的；不矫饰的
words.ex: The house had an unpretentious charm that made it feel welcoming.
words.ex_cn: 这座房子有一种不炫耀的魅力，让人感到宾至如归。
words.en: If you describe a place, person, or thing as unpretentious, you approve of them because they are simple in appearance or character, rather than sophisticated or luxurious.

words.ex: She curls her hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上卷头发。
words.en: To form into a spiral or curved shape; a piece of hair that grows in a curved shape.

words.ex: She was mindful of her words during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 她在会议中留心自己的言辞。
words.en: If you are mindful of something, you think about it and consider it when taking action.

words.tr:
adj. 过去的
n. 过去的事
words.ex: He liked to talk about bygone days with his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢和祖父谈论过去的时光。
words.en: Belonging to an earlier time.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: The old man prays for holiness every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人每天早上祈祷追求圣洁。
words.en: The state or quality of being holy; sanctity.

words.ex: The proximity of the school to the park makes it nice for kids.
words.ex_cn: 学校靠近公园，对孩子们来说很好。
words.en: Proximity refers to the state of being near in space or time.

words.tr: phrase. 赶时髦；跟风；随大流；加入声势日隆的活动或潮流
words.ex: Many people jump on the bandwagon when a new trend becomes popular.
words.ex_cn: 当一种新潮流变得流行时，许多人会跟风。
words.en: To join others in doing something that is becoming fashionable or popular.

words.tr: 短语动词. 趋炎附势；随大流；加入成功者或流行趋势的一方
words.ex: Many politicians climb on the bandwagon when they see a candidate gaining popularity.
words.ex_cn: 许多政客在看到候选人受欢迎时都会趋炎附势。
words.en: To join others in doing something that is becoming fashionable or popular.

words.ex: Many people jumped on the bandwagon of eco-friendly products.
words.ex_cn: 许多人赶上了环保产品的潮流。
words.en: A bandwagon is an activity, group, movement, etc. that has become successful or fashionable and so attracts many new people.

words.ex: He made a mistake in haste.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙中犯了一个错误。
words.en: Haste is the quality of doing something quickly, sometimes too quickly so that you are careless and make mistakes.

words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.tr: n. 兼容性；和睦相处；并存
words.ex: The software has good compatibility with old devices.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件与旧设备兼容性很好。
words.en: The ability of two things to exist or be used together without problems or conflict.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.tr: n. 敏感性；感受力；善感；感情
words.ex: She has great sensibility for music.
words.ex_cn: 她对音乐有很强的感悟力。
words.en: The ability to appreciate and respond to complex emotional or aesthetic influences; sensitivity.

words.tr:
v. 吹嘘；自吹自擂
adj. 一流的；极好的
words.ex: He brags about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他炫耀自己的新车。
words.en: If you brag, you say in a very proud way that you have something or have done something.

words.ex: The loud noise at night will horrify the child.
words.ex_cn: 晚上的巨大噪音会吓到那个孩子。
words.en: To horrify someone means to shock or frighten them very much.

words.tr: phrase. 用钩钩住；和…有联系；安装
words.ex: They decided to hook up the printer to the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定把打印机连接到电脑上。
words.en: To connect or link something to a power supply, a network, or another device; to form a relationship or partnership with someone, especially in a casual or non-serious way.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: He refused the money purely because it was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是因为觉得不对才拒绝了那笔钱。
words.en: In a pure manner; without admixture or adulteration.

words.ex: The state of affairs in the company is worrying.
words.ex_cn: 公司的事态令人担忧。
words.en: The state of affairs is the current situation or condition of things, especially in a particular area or at a particular time.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To originate means to have a specific beginning or to start something.

words.ex: His mindset helps him stay positive during hard times.
words.ex_cn: 他的心态让他在困难时期保持积极。
words.en: A mindset is a set of attitudes or fixed ideas that someone has and that are often difficult to change.

words.ex: The mirror distorts my face.
words.ex_cn: 这面镜子扭曲了我的脸。
words.en: If you distort a statement, fact, or idea, you report or represent it in an untrue way.

words.tr:
n. 强烈的性欲；强烈的欲望
v. 对…有极强的性欲（或欲望）
words.ex: His lust for power ruined his relationships.
words.ex_cn: 他对权力的强烈欲望毁掉了他的关系。
words.en: Lust is a strong feeling of wanting to have or to do something, especially sexual desire.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.tr: n. 机会主义；投机主义
words.ex: He showed opportunism by taking advantage of the crisis.
words.ex_cn: 他利用危机谋取私利，表现出机会主义。
words.en: Opportunism is the practice of taking advantage of opportunities as and when they arise, regardless of planning or principle.

words.ex: Her selflessness was evident in the way she always put others' needs before her own.
words.ex_cn: 她总是把别人的需要放在自己的前面，这充分体现了她的无私。
words.en: Selflessness is the quality of caring more about other people's needs and interests than about your own.

words.ex: In short, he likes pizza.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to introduce a summary of something that has just been said or to give a brief statement of the main points.

words.ex: He spoke with sincerity.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地说话。
words.en: Sincerity is the quality of being free from pretense, deceit, or hypocrisy.

words.ex: He wants to be self-sufficient by growing his own food.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过自己种食物来实现自给自足。
words.en: A self-sufficient person or thing is able to provide for themselves without outside assistance.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人自由行动；放任某人；释放某人；使某人尽情发挥
words.ex: They decided to let him loose in the city to find his own way.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定让他在这个城市里自由行动，自己找出路。
words.en: To allow someone to move freely or do what they want.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人放手去做某事；让某人自由处理某事
words.ex: The teacher decided to let the students loose on the project.
words.ex_cn: 老师决定让学生自由处理这个项目。
words.en: To allow someone to do something freely, especially something that requires creativity or that they have a particular talent for.

words.tr:
n. 锻造车间；
v. 建立（联系等）；
words.ex: The blacksmith works in the forge every morning.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠每天早上都在锻造车间工作。
words.en: To forge something means to create it, especially by using considerable effort or skill. It can also mean to make or produce something, especially with some difficulty or effort. Additionally, it refers to the act of making a copy or imitation of something with the intent to deceive.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: He ignored the frivolous complaint and focused on the real issue.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了这个无关紧要的投诉，专注于真正的问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as frivolous, you mean they behave in a silly or light-hearted way, rather than being serious and sensible.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: He is thin.
words.ex_cn: 他很瘦。
words.en: Having a small distance between opposite sides; not thick.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.tr:
adj. 希腊的；
n. 希腊语；
words.ex: He loves eating Greek food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃的希腊食物。
words.en: Relating to Greece, its people, or their language.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.tr: phrase. 区分，辨别……之间的不同
words.ex: It's important to distinguish between fact and opinion.
words.ex_cn: 重要的是要区分事实和观点。
words.en: To recognize or understand the difference between two or more things or people.

words.tr: n. 效用；实用；公用事业；
words.ex: The utility of this tool is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的效用非常高。
words.en: Utility refers to the state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial.

words.ex: The effects of the medication are impermanent.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物的效果是暂时的。
words.en: Something that is impermanent does not last forever or for a very long time.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.tr: phrase. 以某事为乐；从某事中获得愉悦
words.ex: He takes pleasure in reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他从读书中获得快乐。
words.en: To derive enjoyment or satisfaction from something.

words.tr: phrase. 以做某事为乐；从做某事中获得愉悦
words.ex: She takes great pleasure in painting landscapes.
words.ex_cn: 她非常喜欢画风景画。
words.en: To enjoy or find satisfaction in doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上，就某种程度而言
words.ex: He will help you insofar as he can.
words.ex_cn: 他能帮多少就帮多少。
words.en: to the extent or degree that

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: The cost of lunch was incidental to the main expense.
words.ex_cn: 午餐的费用是主要开销的附带部分。
words.en: If one thing is incidental to another, it is less important than the other thing or is not a major part of it.

words.tr: v. “say”的现在分词；说； n. 谚语；警句；
words.ex: He is saying goodbye to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向朋友们道别。
words.en: A short, well-known expression that states a general truth or gives advice.

words.tr: phrase. 正如俗话所说，用来引出常见的谚语或普遍接受的说法
words.ex: As the saying goes, practice makes perfect.
words.ex_cn: 俗话说，熟能生巧。
words.en: used to introduce a well-known phrase or saying

words.ex: The tribulations of war left many families devastated.
words.ex_cn: 战争的苦难使许多家庭陷入了绝望。
words.en: A tribulation is a cause of great trouble or suffering.

words.tr: phrase. 苦难与磨难；考验与困苦（常指人生中经历的种种艰难处境）
words.ex: The couple faced many trials and tribulations before finding happiness.
words.ex_cn: 这对夫妇在找到幸福之前经历了很多磨难。
words.en: The phrase 'trials and tribulations' refers to the difficulties and problems that one faces in life.

words.ex: The statesman spoke wisely to calm the nation.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家明智地讲话以安抚国家。
words.en: A statesman is a respected political leader or figure, especially one who has had a long and successful career in politics.

words.tr: n. 演说者；演讲者；雄辩家；
words.ex: He is a famous orator who speaks at large events.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在大型活动中演讲的著名演说者。
words.en: An orator is a person who delivers speeches or lectures, especially one who is skilled at doing so.

words.tr: n. 道德规范；伦理标准；
words.ex: The company follows a strong ethic of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司遵循诚实的道德规范。
words.en: An ethic is a moral principle or set of moral principles that guides the behavior of a person or group, especially in a professional context.

words.ex: He is an influential teacher in our school.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们学校一位有影响力的老师。
words.en: Having great influence on someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 至于； 关于；按着；根据
words.ex: I don't know as to when he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他什么时候来。
words.en: Used to indicate what something is about or concerns.

words.ex: The purity of the water is checked every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天都会检查水的纯净度。
words.en: The quality or state of being pure, especially in terms of being free from anything that contaminates, pollutes, or dilutes.

words.ex: He bought equity in a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了一家科技公司的股票。
words.en: Equity is the quality of being fair and impartial.

words.tr: n. 慷慨大方；宽大；心胸开阔
words.ex: His liberality in sharing his wealth was well-known.
words.ex_cn: 他慷慨分享财富的行为是众所周知的。
words.en: The quality of being generous and open-minded.

words.tr: v. 同意；赞成；“agree”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 已一致的；同意的；
words.ex: We agreed to meet at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们同意下午五点见面。
words.en: If people are agreed, they have reached a joint decision on something or have the same opinion about something.

words.w: have the courage of one's convictions
words.tr: phrase. 有勇气坚持自己的信念；敢于按自己的信念行事
words.ex: He has the courage of his convictions and speaks the truth, even when it is hard.
words.ex_cn: 他有坚持自己信念的勇气，即使困难也说真话。
words.en: To have the courage of one's convictions means to be brave enough to do what you believe to be right, even though other people may not agree or approve.

words.w: have the courage of one's own convictions
words.tr: phrase. 有勇气坚持自己的信念；敢于坚持自己认为正确的事情
words.uk: /hæv ðə ˈkʌrɪdʒ ɒv wʌnz əʊn kənˈvɪkʃənz/
words.us: /hæv ðə ˈkɜːrɪdʒ əv wʌnz oʊn kənˈvɪkʃənz/
words.ex: He has the courage of his own convictions and speaks what he believes.
words.ex_cn: 他有坚持自己信念的勇气，并说出自己相信的话。
words.en: To be brave enough to act according to your own beliefs, even when they are not popular or are opposed by others.

words.ex: Honesty is a great virtue.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
words.en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.ex: His superiority in math helped him win the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的优越让他赢得了比赛。
words.en: If one side in a war or conflict has superiority, it has an advantage over its enemy, for example because it has more soldiers or better equipment.

words.ex: He surpassed his brother in math scores.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学成绩上超过了他弟弟。
words.en: If one person or thing surpasses another, the first is better than, or has more of a particular quality than, the second.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: She is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个好学生。
words.en: Something that is good is of a high quality, standard, or level.

words.tr: adj. 品行端正的；品德高的；
words.ex: He is a virtuous man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个品行端正的人，总是说真话。
words.en: Having or showing high moral standards.

words.ex: He bind the books with string.
words.ex_cn: 他用绳子把书捆起来。
words.en: To tie something or someone tightly or to fasten something.

words.ex: He gave his last dollar to the homeless man, showing an altruistic heart.
words.ex_cn: 他把最后一美元给了那个无家可归的人，表现出一颗无私的心。
words.en: If you describe someone as altruistic, you mean that they show unselfish concern for the welfare of others.

words.tr: adv. 幼稚地; 天真地，幼小地
words.ex: He behaved childishly when he refused to share his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝分享他的玩具，表现得非常幼稚。
words.en: In a manner that is characteristic of a child; immaturely or naively.

words.tr: phrase. 优等民族（纳粹意识形态中自认为比其他民族优越并有权统治其他民族的种族）
words.ex: The concept of a master race was a key ideology of the Nazi regime.
words.ex_cn: 优等民族的概念是纳粹政权的核心意识形态。
words.en: A group of people considered to be superior to others and therefore justified in ruling over them.

words.tr: adj. 国家主义的；民族主义的
words.ex: His nationalistic views often led to conflict with other political factions.
words.ex_cn: 他的民族主义观点常常与其他政治派别发生冲突。
words.en: If you describe someone as nationalistic, you mean they are very proud of their nation. They also often believe that their nation is better than any other nation, and in this case, you can describe them as chauvinistic nationalistic.

words.ex: He is the all-time best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队历史上最棒的球员。
words.en: You use all-time to describe something that is the best, worst, greatest, or most extreme of its kind that has ever existed.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.tr: phrase. 对某物留意着；中意某物；暗中关注某物
words.ex: She has her eye on that new car.
words.ex_cn: 她看中了那辆新车。
words.en: To be interested in or desire something, often with the intention of acquiring it.

words.tr: phrase. 助跑跳远（田径项目，运动员通过助跑后起跳，尽可能向前跳跃的竞技项目）
words.ex: In the running broad jump, athletes aim to cover the maximum distance with a single leap.
words.ex_cn: 在助跑跳远中，运动员的目标是用一次跳跃达到最远的距离。
words.en: A track and field event in which the competitor runs down a strip and jumps as far as possible from a take-off board.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.ex: I kind of like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我有点喜欢披萨。
words.en: To some extent; somewhat.

words.tr: phrase. 轻松获胜；毫无悬念地赢
words.ex: He wins hands down in every chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在每场象棋比赛中都轻松获胜。
words.en: If you win something hands down, you win it very easily, often because you are much better than the other competitors.

words.tr: phrase. 轻而易举地击败某人；毫无悬念地战胜某人
words.ex: She won the competition hands down.
words.ex_cn: 她轻而易举地赢得了比赛。
words.en: To defeat someone very easily in a competition or argument.

words.tr: phrase. 轻松赢得某物；毫无悬念地获胜
words.ex: She won the race hands down.
words.ex_cn: 她轻而易举地赢得了比赛。
words.en: To win something very easily, without much effort.

words.tr: phrase. 即将经历（通常指不愉快的事情）；注定要遭遇
words.ex: You're in for a big surprise.
words.ex_cn: 你将会大吃一惊。
words.en: To be about to experience something, especially something unpleasant.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.tr: phrase. 保密的；秘密进行的
words.ex: The details of the new project are still under wraps.
words.ex_cn: 新项目的细节仍然保密。
words.en: If something is under wraps, it is being kept secret.

words.tr:
n. 纳粹党人
adj. 纳粹党的
words.ex: He hated the nazi regime.
words.ex_cn: 他憎恨纳粹政权。
words.en: A member of the National Socialist German Workers' Party, which controlled Germany from 1933 to 1945 under Adolf Hitler.

words.tr:
n. 雅利安人；印欧语
adj. 雅利安人的；印欧语系的
words.ex: The term 'Aryan' has been used in various contexts throughout history.
words.ex_cn: “雅利安”一词在历史上曾被用于不同的语境。
words.en: relating to or denoting a people speaking an Indo-European language who invaded northern India in the 2nd millennium BC, displacing the Dravidian and other aboriginal peoples.

words.ex: He used the word negro to describe the man, which made everyone uncomfortable.
words.ex_cn: 他用‘黑人’这个词来描述那个男人，这让所有人都感到不舒服。
words.en: A term for a person of African descent, now considered offensive in most contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 愤怒的；恼火的；激动的
words.ex: He got hot under the collar when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个消息后变得心烦意乱。
words.en: If you say that someone is hot under the collar, you mean that they are very angry about something.

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.ex: The plane's takeoff was delayed by strong wind.
words.ex_cn: 飞机的起飞因强风而延误了。
words.en: Takeoff is the beginning of a flight, when an aircraft leaves the ground.

words.tr:
adj. 肮脏恶臭的；
v. 对…犯规；
words.ex: The foul smell came from the garbage bin.
words.ex_cn: 那股恶臭来自垃圾桶。
words.en: If you describe something as foul, you mean it is dirty and smells or tastes unpleasant. In sports, a foul is an act that is against the rules of the game.

words.tr: phrase. 出丑；闹笑话；让自己出洋相
words.ex: He made a fool of himself at the party by singing loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上大声唱歌，出丑了。
words.en: To behave in a way that makes other people think you are silly or not to be respected.

words.ex: She looked at the mess disgustedly and left the room.
words.ex_cn: 她厌烦地看着那片混乱，然后离开了房间。
words.en: In a manner that shows strong disapproval or distaste.

words.ex: They shook hands with a firm handshake.
words.ex_cn: 他们以坚定的握手示意友好。
words.en: A handshake is a gesture in which two people grasp one of each other's like hands, in most cases accompanied by a brief up and down movement of the grasped hands.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.tr: n. 至高无上；最大权力；最高地位；
words.ex: The king claimed supremacy over all other rulers.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣称自己对所有其他统治者拥有至高无上的权力。
words.en: Supremacy is the state or condition of being superior to all others in authority, power, or status.

words.tr: phrase. 看上去像那么回事；外表符合角色或职位要求
words.ex: He wears a suit and tie, so he looks the part of a businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着西装和领带，看起来像个商人。
words.en: To appear suitable for a particular role or to seem appropriate for a specific situation.

words.tr: adj. 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；
words.ex: He has a muscular arm from lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他因为举重而拥有强壮的手臂。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the muscles; having well-developed muscles.

words.ex: The blond man smiled at the children.
words.ex_cn: 那个白肤金发的男子对孩子们微笑了。
words.en: If someone has blond hair, it is pale yellow in color.

words.tr: adv. 醒目地；显著地；惊人地；
words.ex: The painting is strikingly colorful.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画醒目地色彩鲜艳。
words.en: In a way that is very noticeable or obvious.

words.tr: adj. 凿刻的，轮廓分明的 v. 凿，雕，镌( chisel的过去式 )
words.ex: He has a chiseled jawline.
words.ex_cn: 他有着轮廓分明的下颌。
words.en: Having a clear, sharp, and defined outline or shape, often as a result of being shaped with a chisel.

words.tr:
n. 退潮；衰退；减少
v. 退潮；衰退；减少
words.ex: The ebb of the tide left fish on the sand.
words.ex_cn: 退潮把鱼留在了沙滩上。
words.en: The movement of the tide out to sea.

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.ex: The soldiers were given quarters near the base.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们被安排在基地附近的住处。
words.en: Quarters can refer to one of four equal parts into which something is divided, a period of three months, a period of 15 minutes, or a place where someone lives or stays.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: I congratulate you on your success.
words.ex_cn: 我祝贺你取得成功。
words.en: If you congratulate someone, you express pleasure for something good that has happened to them, or you praise them for something they have achieved.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.tr:
v. 伪造；假装；冒充；
adj. 假的；冒充的；伪造的；
words.ex: He faked a signature to get the money.
words.ex_cn: 他伪造了一个签名来拿到钱。
words.en: If something is fake, it is not real, genuine, or true, but is made to appear so.

words.tr:
n. 紧握；掌握；控制；
v. 紧握；掌握；
words.ex: He has a strong grip on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住把手。
words.en: To grip something means to hold it tightly. It can also mean to hold someone's attention completely.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.tr: phrase. （核反应堆）熔毁；熔化；情绪崩溃；瓦解
words.ex: The ice cream will melt down in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰淇淋在太阳下会融化。
words.en: If a substance melts down, it becomes liquid because it has been heated. In a figurative sense, if a situation or system melts down, it fails or collapses suddenly and completely.

words.tr: n. 电镀；镀层; v. 电镀（plate 的现在分词）
words.ex: The plating on the metal started to peel off.
words.ex_cn: 金属上的镀层开始剥落。
words.en: Plating is the process of covering a metal object with a thin layer of another metal, especially by electrolysis.

words.tr: n. 克拉（宝石重量单位）；开（含纯金的量）
words.ex: The diamond weighs two carats.
words.ex_cn: 这颗钻石重两克拉。
words.en: A unit of weight for precious stones and pearls, equivalent to 200 milligrams.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.ex: She was raring to go on the trip.
words.ex_cn: 她对这次旅行充满了渴望。
words.en: If you are raring to do something, you are very eager and enthusiastic about doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 处在最佳状态；在全盛时期
words.ex: She is at her best when she sings on stage.
words.ex_cn: 当她站在舞台上唱歌时，她是最出色的。
words.en: If you are at your best, you are performing or behaving as well as you are able to.

words.ex: His behavioral changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to the way in which someone behaves.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: His eccentricity makes him unique.
words.ex_cn: 他的古怪使他与众不同。
words.en: The quality of being eccentric; behaviour that is unusual, peculiar, or odd.

words.ex: The dog learned through conditioning to sit when it hears a whistle.
words.ex_cn: 狗通过条件作用学会在听到口哨时坐下。
words.en: The process of training or accustoming a person or animal to behave in a certain way or to accept certain circumstances.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.tr: n. 时间生物学；生物钟学
words.ex: He studies chronobiology to understand sleep patterns.
words.ex_cn: 他研究时间生物学以了解睡眠模式。
words.en: Chronobiology is the study of periodic (cyclic) phenomena in living organisms and their adaptation to solar- and lunar-related rhythms.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.tr: phrase. 血细胞，血液中的细胞成分，包括红细胞、白细胞和血小板
words.ex: The doctor checked the number of blood cells in his sample.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他样本中的血细胞数量。
words.en: A blood cell is any of the cells that are found in blood and that are involved in transporting oxygen or in fighting infection.

words.tr: v. 给予；发出；“give”的过去式；
words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: Past tense of give, which means to freely transfer the possession of something to someone.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.ex: His metabolic rate is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的新陈代谢率很高。
words.en: Relating to or involving the chemical processes that occur within a living organism in order to maintain life.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: The car will accelerate when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会加速。
words.en: To accelerate means to start to go faster or to make something start to go faster.

words.ex: The new machine improves the efficiency of production.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器提高了生产的效率。
words.en: Efficiency is the ability to do something or produce something without wasting materials, time, or energy.

words.ex: He follows his circadian rhythm to sleep and wake up.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循自己的昼夜节律来睡觉和醒来。
words.en: Relating to or exhibiting approximately 24-hour periodicity.

words.tr: adj. 最重要的；一流的；处于领导地位的； v. “lead”的现在分词；带领；领导；
words.ex: He is the leading scientist in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的科学家。
words.en: If something is leading in a particular area, it is the most important or advanced thing in that area.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.ex: The physiologist studied how the heart pumps blood.
words.ex_cn: 这位生理学家研究了心脏如何泵血。
words.en: A physiologist is a person who studies the way that the bodies of living things work.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.ex: The space-shuttle launched successfully this morning.
words.ex_cn: n. 今天早上航天飞机成功发射。
words.en: A space shuttle is a spacecraft designed for repeated use, capable of carrying astronauts and cargo into space and returning to Earth.

words.ex: The chronobiologist studies the effects of time on biological processes.
words.ex_cn: 时间生物学家研究时间对生物过程的影响。
words.en: A scientist who studies chronobiology, the science dealing with the biological rhythms of living organisms.

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: She coordinates the team's schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她协调团队的安排。
words.en: If you coordinate an activity, you organize the various people and things involved in it. If you coordinate the different parts of your body, you make them work together efficiently.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.tr:
v. 把…联系在一起；
adj. 副的；
n. 同事；伙伴；
words.ex: He associates happiness with family time.
words.ex_cn: 他把幸福与家庭时光联系在一起。
words.en: If you associate someone or something with a particular quality or idea, or if they are associated with it, you connect them in your mind with that quality or idea.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.tr: phrase. 坐标纸；方格纸（用于绘图或数学计算的印有方格的纸）
words.ex: She used graph paper to plot her data points.
words.ex_cn: 她使用方格纸来绘制她的数据点。
words.en: Paper printed with a pattern of small squares, used for drawing graphs or diagrams.

words.ex: He wants to familiarize himself with the new software.
words.ex_cn: 他想熟悉这个新软件。
words.en: To familiarize someone with something means to give them knowledge or experience of it.

words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.tr: adj. 要求高的；费力的； v. 需要；“demand”的现在分词；
words.ex: The job is demanding because it needs long hours and high focus.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作要求高，因为它需要长时间工作和高度专注。
words.en: Requiring much effort or attention; exacting.

words.ex: The watch works with great precision.
words.ex_cn: 这块手表运行得非常精确。
words.en: Precision is the quality of being exact and accurate.

words.ex: He solved a mathematical problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了一个数学问题。
words.en: Relating to or using mathematics; precise and exact.

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；对比而言
words.ex: He likes coffee. By contrast, she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡。相比之下，她更喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: The doctor checked his daily intake of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他每天的糖摄入量。
words.en: The process of taking something in, especially food, air, or information.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: He drinks coffee to get caffeine.
words.ex_cn: 他喝咖啡来获取咖啡因。
words.en: A bitter alkaloid found in coffee and tea that is responsible for their stimulating effects.

words.tr: n. 阿司匹林（镇痛解热消炎药）
words.ex: He took aspirin for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了阿司匹林来缓解头痛。
words.en: Aspirin is a common drug that is used to reduce pain and inflammation.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.ex: He works at a small pharmacy near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一家小药房工作。
words.en: A pharmacy is a shop or a department in a shop where medicines are prepared and sold.

words.ex: Caffeine is a common stimulant.
words.ex_cn: 咖啡因是一种常见的兴奋剂。
words.en: A stimulant is a substance that raises levels of physiological or nervous activity in the body.

words.tr:
adj. 镇静的；镇定的；止痛的
n. 镇静剂；止痛药
words.ex: The doctor gave her a sedative pill to calm her down.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了她一颗镇静药片来让她平静下来。
words.en: A sedative is a drug that calms you down or makes you sleep.

words.tr:
adj. 安详的；安静的；镇静的
v. 给…服镇静剂
words.ex: The sedate old man sat quietly by the window.
words.ex_cn: 那位安详的老人安静地坐在窗边。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as sedate, you mean that they are quiet, calm, and dignified.

words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.tr: n. 不规则；无规律；不合常规；不整齐
words.ex: The teacher noticed an irregularity in the test scores.
words.ex_cn: 老师注意到考试成绩中有一个异常。
words.en: The state or quality of being irregular; something that is irregular.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: Beware of the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当心那只狗。
words.en: to be cautious and alert to the dangers of.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.ex: The regularity of his daily routine helps him stay focused.
words.ex_cn: 他日常作息的规律性帮助他保持专注。
words.en: The quality or state of being regular; the condition of being governed by or according to rules, principles, or established customs.

words.ex: The two devices need synchronization to work together.
words.ex_cn: 这两个设备需要同步才能一起工作。
words.en: The process of causing things to happen or operate at the same time or rate.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.ex: The tombstone was engraved with the deceased's name and date of birth and death.
words.ex_cn: 墓碑上刻着死者的名字和出生及死亡日期。
words.en: A tombstone is a large stone with words carved into it, which is placed on a grave.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: The hibiscus flower is known for its vibrant colors.
words.ex_cn: 木槿花以其鲜艳的色彩而闻名。
words.en: A hibiscus is a tropical plant that has large, brightly coloured flowers.

words.ex: The cat sat on the sill near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在窗边的窗台上。
words.en: A sill is a flat piece of stone, wood, or metal at the base of a window or door.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.ex: He is a billionaire who owns many companies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位拥有许多公司的亿万富翁。
words.en: A billionaire is an extremely rich person who has money or property worth at least a billion dollars or pounds.

words.tr: n. 显要人物；有权势的人；
words.ex: He is a media mogul who owns several TV channels.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位拥有多个电视频道的显要人物。
words.en: A mogul is a person who possesses a great deal of power, influence, or wealth, especially in a particular industry.

words.ex: She lamented the death of her dog.
words.ex_cn: 她哀悼她狗的去世。
words.en: If you lament something, you express your sadness, regret, or disappointment about it.

words.tr:
v. 夺取；一把抓住
n. 夺取；一把抓住；音乐片段
words.ex: He tried to snatch the bag from her hand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图从她手中抢走包。
words.en: If you snatch something, or if you snatch at it, you take it or pull it away quickly.

words.tr:
adv. 极其地
adj. 异常巨大的；非常重要的
words.ex: They launched a mega marketing campaign.
words.ex_cn: 他们启动了一场宏大的营销活动。
words.en: extremely large or great

words.ex: The company made a megadeal with a multinational corporation.
words.ex_cn: 该公司与一家跨国公司达成了特大交易。
words.en: A megadeal is a very large and significant business deal, often involving a substantial amount of money or important strategic implications.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 勾掉；划掉（清单上的项目）
words.ex: He crosses off one task from the list every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天从清单上划掉一项任务。
words.en: To remove something from a list or to indicate that something has been dealt with by drawing a line through it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 为…而哭泣，对…感到难过（通常指对无法改变的事情感到悲伤）
words.ex: He cries over his lost toy.
words.ex_cn: 他为他丢失的玩具哭泣。
words.en: If you say that someone is crying over something, you mean that they are expressing sadness or regret about it, especially when it is too late to change the situation.

words.tr: adj. 不再抱幻想的； v. “disillusion”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He became disillusioned after seeing the truth.
words.ex_cn: 在看到真相后，他不再抱幻想了。
words.en: If you are disillusioned with something, you are disappointed because it is not as good as you had expected.

words.tr: v. 集中；聚焦；“focus”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 注意力集中的；聚焦的；
words.ex: He focused on his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you are focused on something, you are paying special attention to it because it is your main concern or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 无伴奏合唱的；无乐器伴奏的
words.ex: The choir performed an a cappella rendition of the classic hymn.
words.ex_cn: 合唱团无伴奏演唱了这首经典圣歌。
words.en: Without instrumental accompaniment.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 顺便访问；顺道拜访
words.ex: I will drop by your house after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去你家拜访。
words.en: To visit someone casually and usually without having arranged it before.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.ex: There was a dip in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额有所下降。
words.en: To dip something means to put it into a liquid and then take it out again.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.tr: phrase. 被迷住的；对…产生好感的；喜欢上…的
words.ex: He is taken with the new teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被这位新老师吸引了。
words.en: If you are taken with someone or something, you are very interested in them or attracted to them.

words.tr: v. 洗脑；通过宣传说服
words.ex: He was brainwashed by the cult.
words.ex_cn: 他被这个邪教洗脑了。
words.en: To brainwash someone means to make them believe something by continually telling them that it is true and preventing them from thinking about it properly.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.tr: n. 商业主义；营利主义；重商主义
words.ex: He hates commercialism in movies.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌电影中的商业主义。
words.en: Commercialism is the practices, methods, aims, and spirit of commerce or business.

words.ex: The windows fog up when we breathe on them.
words.ex_cn: 当我们往窗户上哈气时，它们会起雾。
words.en: To become covered with small drops of water, making it difficult to see through.

words.tr:
v. 狼吞虎咽；吞并；火鸡咯咯叫
n. 火鸡叫声
words.ex: The dog will gobble up its food quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗会很快把食物狼吞虎咽地吃掉。
words.en: To eat something quickly and eagerly, often making a noise.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.tr: n. 同伴（同僚）之谊，友谊，同志关系
words.ex: Their comradeship was forged in the heat of battle.
words.ex_cn: 他们的同志情谊是在战斗的烈火中锻造出来的。
words.en: The mutual trust and friendship among people who share the same activities or goals.

words.tr: adv. 晚期地；末端地；最后地；致命地
words.ex: He was terminally ill and needed constant care.
words.ex_cn: 他病入膏肓，需要持续的照顾。
words.en: In a way that relates to or is in the final stages of a fatal disease.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: The new policy drastically reduced costs.
words.ex_cn: 新政策大幅度降低了成本。
words.en: In a way that is likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

words.ex: He does meditation every morning to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以放松。
words.en: Meditation is the act of remaining in a silent and calm state for a period of time, as part of a religious training, or so that you are more able to deal with the problems of everyday life.

words.ex: The therapist helped him feel better after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 治疗专家在事故后帮助他感觉好些了。
words.en: A therapist is a person who is skilled in a particular type of therapy and treats people using it.

words.ex: He checks his bank account every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天检查他的银行账户。
words.en: A bank account is an arrangement by which a bank holds money on behalf of a customer, who can deposit and withdraw funds.

words.ex: The drought depletes the water supply.
words.ex_cn: 干旱耗尽了水源。
words.en: If you deplete something, you reduce the amount of it that is available or that exists.

words.ex: The red team played versus the blue team.
words.ex_cn: 红队与蓝队比赛。
words.en: Used to indicate the two sides in a competition or conflict.

words.ex: He says hello every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都说你好。
words.en: To express in words; to state or declare.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.ex: The mistake was trivial and didn't affect the result.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误不重要，没有影响结果。
words.en: If you describe something as trivial, you mean that it is not important or significant, or is not worth serious consideration.

words.tr: n. （掩护阵地和活动的）烟幕
words.ex: He used lies as a smokescreen to hide the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他用谎言作为烟幕来掩盖真相。
words.en: A smokescreen is a cloud of smoke created to hide military operations. In a non-military context, it refers to an action or statement intended to conceal or mislead.

words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.ex: He looks down on people who work hard.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起努力工作的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.ex: He felt envious when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到嫉妒。
words.en: If you are envious of someone, you want something that they have.

words.ex: He says he likes quiet, on the contrary, he always listens to loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢安静，相反，他总是听大声的音乐。
words.en: You use 'on the contrary' when you are contradicting what has just been said or implied, or making a contrast between two things.

words.tr:
v. 戳；刺；捅
n. 戳；刺；捅
words.ex: He poked the fire with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子戳了戳火。
words.en: To poke means to prod or jab someone or something with a finger or a pointed object, or to move something in a particular direction with a sharp movement. It can also refer to the act of making a hole or opening in something by pushing a pointed object into it.

words.ex: He wants to go to graduate school after college.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学毕业后读研究生院。
words.en: A graduate school is a school that awards advanced academic degrees (such as master's and doctoral degrees) with the general requirement that students must have earned a previous undergraduate (bachelor's) degree.

words.tr: phrase. 学生群体；全体学生
words.ex: The student body is very diverse.
words.ex_cn: 学生群体非常多元化。
words.en: The student body refers to all the students of a particular school, college, or university considered as a group.

words.ex: He was a beanpole, standing at six feet tall with a slender build.
words.ex_cn: 他是个瘦高个，身高六英尺，体形纤细。
words.en: A beanpole is a tall, thin person.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his hip.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤到了臀部。
words.en: The hip is the area on each side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

words.tr: v. 卸去负荷( unburden的过去式和过去分词 ); 吐露心事，消除（思想、心灵上的）负担
words.ex: He felt unburdened after telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他说出真相后感到轻松了。
words.en: If you are unburdened, you are free from worries or responsibilities.

words.ex: The pharmacist gave me medicine for my cough.
words.ex_cn: 药剂师给了我治咳嗽的药。
words.en: A pharmacist is a person who is qualified to prepare and dispense medicinal drugs.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.tr: n. 运作方式；力学；“mechanic”的复数；
words.ex: The mechanics of this machine are simple to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运作方式很简单易懂。
words.en: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on bodies and with motion, comprised of kinetics, statics, and kinematics.

words.tr:
n. 卷轴；
v. 卷动；
words.ex: He unrolled the ancient scroll.
words.ex_cn: 他展开了一卷古老的卷轴。
words.en: A scroll is a roll of paper or parchment with writing or pictures on it. As a verb, to scroll means to move displayed text or graphics on a screen in a particular direction in order to view different parts of them.

words.ex: She earned a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science.
words.ex_cn: 她获得了计算机科学理学学士学位。
words.en: A Bachelor of Science (BS, BSc, SB, or ScB; from the Latin scientiae baccalaureus) is an undergraduate academic degree awarded for completed courses that generally last three to five years.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: The doctor will certify that you are healthy.
words.ex_cn: 医生将证明你身体健康。
words.en: To officially declare something to be true, correct, or genuine, often in writing.

words.ex: This factory specializes in making electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂专用于制造电动汽车。
words.en: If you specialize in a particular subject or skill, you become an expert in it by focusing your studies or work on it.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 雇佣中介；职业介绍所
words.ex: He found a job through an employment agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家职业介绍所找到了工作。
